name: list_blocks
description: List library blocks (up to ~200) grouped by category: slug, name, tags. Use for a broad menu; search_blocks ranks and filters. `categories` / `styles` arrays OR-match in one call.

style.description: One vibe; auto-set from the site's buildStyle.

name: get_component_schema
description: Full prop schemas for components (types, props, valid values). Pass a comma list to get only what you need. In parallel fill, responses are compact and `components` is required.

components.description: Comma-separated names, e.g. "Container,Text,Button". Omit for all.

name: get_style_reference
description: Styling reference: palette variables, styleGuide tokens, spatial scale, modifiers, interactive state, form-confirmation recipe. Pass `topic` for a focused guide (design bar, accessibility, domains, per-tool usage).

topic.description: Return one guide instead of the core reference.

name: generate_button_classes
description: Canonical Button className + activeModifiers from intent (variant, shape, size). A starting point — you may append classes.

responsive.description: Full width on mobile, auto on desktop (default true).

name: validate_button_classes
description: Check a Button className for variant conflicts and token misuse; optionally auto-fix it.

allowCustomClasses.description: false = hardcoded colors are errors, not warnings (default true).

name: list_presets
description: Curated theme presets (palette + fonts + tokens). compact: true returns id + name only. Apply one with set_theme({ preset }).

name: create_template
description:
Creates a new site from the acme base template with an empty page_home container. Saves to the API and auto-selects as active site.

Workflow: create_template → set_theme (includes company variables) → apply_kit_block(target:"header") → apply_kit_block (repeat for page sections) → apply_kit_block(target:"footer") → update_page (set SEO title/description)

slug.description: URL-safe name for the site (e.g. "bookstore-jazz", "my-portfolio"). Used as internal reference.

description.description: Short description ≤75 chars (e.g. "Cozy bookstore with jazz lounge vibes").

hidden.description: If true, hidden from public gallery. Default: false.

name: set_theme
description: Write the site theme — preset, palette, darkPalette, styleGuide tokens and fonts, JSON-LD — straight into the draft. Call first on a new site, then set ROOT `company` vars with patch_site_node. For "suggest palettes / pick fonts" requests use suggest_palettes / suggest_font_pairings instead. Palette names, styleGuide keys, workflow: get_style_reference({ topic: "theme" }).

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

preset.description: Preset slug; loads palette, fonts and styleGuide. Explicit params override it.

buildStyle.description: Vibe override for block filtering. Rarely needed — preset sets it.

palette.description: Complete palette — replaces the existing one. [{ name, color }] with DaisyUI names (Primary, Primary Content, Secondary, Accent, Neutral, Base 100/200/300, Base Content, …), never "Background"/"Foreground". Colors: hex, rgb, hsl or oklch().

darkPalette.description: Optional dark-mode palette with the same names. Enables dark mode.

styleGuide.description: Design tokens, merged into the existing styleGuide; each key becomes a CSS var (headingFontFamily, bodyFontFamily, radiusBox, buttonPadding, contentWidth, input*Color, …). Key list: get_style_reference({ topic: "theme" }).

fonts.description: Hint ({ url } or { families }) parsed into heading/body families when styleGuide omits them.

jsonLd.description: Schema.org JSON-LD object; {{company.*}} variables work inside it.

name: add_block
description:
Appends a pre-built block template to the active site. Use list_blocks to see all available template IDs and their descriptions.

Overrides let you customize content and styling without hand-crafting nodes. Keys in contentOverrides and propOverrides are matched by the node's custom.displayName (e.g. "Title", "Subtitle", "CTA Button", "Image").

Call list_blocks first to see available IDs and their displayName targets.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

templateId.description: Block template ID. Use list_blocks to see all available IDs. Examples: "hero-1", "hero-2", "header-1", "footer-1", "pricing-1", "services-1", "imagetext-1", "optin-1", "texts-1", "team-1".

contentOverrides.description:
Map of displayName → content patch. Patches the node's top-level props (text, url, src, alt, icon, etc.). Examples: {"Title": {"text": "Welcome to our store"}, "CTA Button": {"text": "Shop Now", "url": "/shop"}, "Image": {"src": "https://example.com/hero.jpg"}} For Text nodes: set "text" (plain text or inline HTML with , ,
, ). For Button nodes: set "text", "url", "icon". For Image nodes: set "src" (URL), "alt", "type" ("url" for external images).

pageId.description: Target page node ID to add the block to (e.g. "page_about"). Default: "page_home". Use list_pages to see available pages.

position.description: Insert index in page's nodes. 0 = first section. Default: append to end.

name: add_custom_block
description:
Merges a hand-crafted flat CraftJS node map into the active site and attaches blockRootId as a child of page_home (or parentNodeId). Use this when no pre-built block template fits your needs.

Use get_component_schema to see all available component types and their props. Each node in the map must have: type.resolvedName, props (with className for Tailwind classes), parent, nodes[], and custom.displayName.

The blockRootId node should have type "section" and canDelete: true.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

sectionRootId.description: Node ID of the block root in your nodes map. This gets attached to page_home. Use descriptive IDs like "sec_testimonials", "sec_gallery".

parentNodeId.description: Parent node to attach to. Default: "page_home". For multi-page sites, pass the target page ID (e.g. "page_about") to add sections to a specific page.

position.description: Insert index in parent's nodes array. Default: append to end.

name: delete_node
description: Delete a node and its subtree. ROOT, page_home, hdr_root and ftr_root can't be deleted.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: move_node
description: Move a node and its subtree to a new parent. Can't move ROOT or page_home, or into its own subtree.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

position.description: Index in the new parent (default: end).

name: insert_node
description: Insert one node under an existing parent. `node` = { type: { resolvedName }, isCanvas, props: { className, …, custom: { displayName } }, nodes: [] }; parent and linkedNodes are set for you. Lists/tables: a Container with props.type "ul" | "li" | "table" | "tr" | "td" ….

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

node.description: Node definition (shape in the tool description).

modifiers.description: { Text: [{ name, classes, requires }], … } upserted into ROOT.props.modifiers. Only needed when className uses shortcut modifier names. See get_style_reference({ topic: "editing" }).

name: get_site_node
description: Read one node's raw JSON. propsPatch REPLACES string props, so read a string (e.g. ROOT.props.inject.head) before editing it to keep its other content.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: list_site_nodes
description: Lightweight node tree (id, displayName, type, child count) in DFS order, ~2KB. Use it to find ids and section order.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: search_site_nodes
description: Find nodes by text/displayName/id (`q`), component `type`, or className substring/regex. className filters return the full className — use them for site-wide class audits.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

type.description: Component type, e.g. Text, Button, Container.

name: list_example_blocks
description: Lists all top-level blocks in a page, showing their node IDs, display names, component types, and descendant counts. Use this to find block root IDs before calling extract_block.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

pageId.description: Target page node ID (e.g. "page_about"). Default: page_home or first page found. Use list_pages to see available pages.

name: extract_block
description:
Extracts a block from a site and converts it to hierarchical block template format ({type, props, children}). This is the reverse of add_block — useful for mining existing sites into reusable templates.

Use list_example_blocks first to find block root IDs. The output can be passed directly to save_as_block_template.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

sectionRootId.description: Node ID of the block root. Get this from list_example_blocks.

templatize.description: If true, attempt to replace hardcoded years with {{year}} and flag hardcoded colors for manual palette mapping. Default: false.

name: save_as_block_template
description:
Saves a block template structure into a category file in data/section-templates/. Creates the category file if it doesn't exist. Template IDs must be globally unique across all categories.

Workflow: list_example_blocks → extract_block → (review/edit) → save_as_block_template

categoryName.description: Human-readable category name. Only needed when creating a new category file (e.g. "Testimonials", "Contact Sections").

templateId.description: Unique template ID (e.g. "testimonials-1", "gallery-2"). Must be globally unique across all categories.

visual.description: Prose description of what the rendered section looks like. Helps AI agents pick the right template.

structure.description: Hierarchical section structure {type, props, children}. Output from extract_section or hand-crafted.

name: shuffle_block
description:
Swaps a block with an alternative template of the same type while preserving the user's content. Identifies the block's category (hero, pricing, testimonials, etc.) from its template origin, picks a different template from the same category, extracts text/image content from the old block, and re-applies it to the new layout.

Workflow: list_example_blocks → shuffle_block(sectionRootId) → done.

If targetTemplateId is omitted, picks a random alternative. Returns the list of remaining alternatives the user can try.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

sectionRootId.description: Node ID of the block root to replace. Get this from list_example_blocks.

targetTemplateId.description: Specific template ID to swap to (e.g. "hero-3"). If omitted, picks a random alternative from the same category.

pageId.description: Page node ID the section lives on. Default: page_home.

name: audit_seo
description: Score a site or template page for SEO: meta, heading hierarchy, alt text, link text, content depth. Returns fixes with node ids.

id.description: Site id. Not with templateSlug.

templateSlug.description: Template to audit instead of a site.

name: register
description: Register a free PageHub account. Returns an API key. Use git config user.email to get the email automatically — do not ask the user unless git email is unavailable. After receiving the key, write it as PAGEHUB_API_KEY in the MCP server env config (.mcp.json) and restart the MCP server.

name.description: Display name (optional, derived from email if omitted)

name: list_templates
description: List stock templates. Filter by category, tag or q.

name: pull_template
description: Download a stock template's decoded node tree.

name: save_template
description: Save a new site template to the catalog. Creates a reusable template from a CraftJS flat node map. Requires admin or tenant owner/editor role.

content.description: Full CraftJS flat node map (same format as pull_site output)

hidden.description: If true, hidden from public gallery. Default: false

isPublic.description: Visible to all users. Default: true

sortOrder.description: Catalog sort order (lower first; ties by title). Default: 0

name: publish_site_as_template
description: Copies the active site's full content into a new template in the catalog. No need to pass content — it reads from the site automatically. Use this after building a site to publish it as a reusable template.

slug.description: URL-safe unique slug for the template (defaults to site slug)

hidden.description: If true, hidden from public gallery

isPublic.description: Visible to all users. Default: true

sortOrder.description: Catalog sort order (lower first; ties by title). Default: 0

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: update_template
description: Update an existing template you own (or any template if admin). Change title, description, content, category, tags, or visibility.

slug.description: Slug of the template to update

sortOrder.description: Catalog sort order (lower first; ties by title)

name: delete_template
description: Delete a template you own (or any template if admin).

name: list_sites
description: List all sites belonging to the authenticated tenant (remote).

name: select_site
description: Set the active site for this session and clear any active template. The hosted server doesn't keep it between calls — still pass `id` on every call.

id.description: Site id.

name: select_template
description: Make a template the edit target for this session; editing tools then act on it (clears the active site). Admin or tenant owner/editor only.

slug.description: Template slug to set as active

name: pull_site
description: Fetches the FULL site content (100KB+). Prefer list_site_nodes (lightweight tree summary, ~2KB) or search_site_nodes (find nodes by name/type) for most tasks. Only use pull_site when you need the complete props/className of many nodes at once.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: create_site
description: Create a site from a template (default "acme", the blank starter) and return its id. Build it with the granular tools — never a full node map.

name: update_site
description: Update the site's name (URL slug), title or description. title/description are the fallback <title> and meta description for every page without its own seo — update_page can't reach them. Empty string clears. Read current values with select_site.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name.description: URL slug (subdomain): lowercase letters, digits, hyphens.

name: publish_site
description: Publish the draft so it goes live. Every write is staged until this runs. `static` switches static delivery on/off (omit to leave it).

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

static.description: true = static-export renderer, false = React renderer.

name: unpublish_site
description: Take the site offline.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: duplicate_site
description: Copy a site you're a member of into a new site you own (content, title, description, portal, crawlPolicy). Domain and published state are not copied. The copy becomes active.

id.description: Source site id.

name: screenshot_site
description: Screenshot the DRAFT in a real browser — the only way to see compiled CSS, theme, state-driven UI and responsive layout. Shoot sections with `selector` (fullPage can miss late paint), at the design width and at 390.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: list_site_emails
description: List the site's transactional emails (receipt, welcome, gift card, sign-in link, downloads): customized or default, and whether each sends. Start here.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: get_site_email
description: Read one site email: subject, preheader, node tree, allowed {{variables.*}} and EmailSlot nodes (keep required slots exactly once). Emails use only Container, Text, Button, Image, EmailSlot and email-safe classes (no btn/card/shadow/gradient/absolute).

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: update_site_email
description: Save a site email's subject, preheader and/or full flat node map, or reset: true. Validated: unknown variables, missing/duplicate required slots and unsupported classes are rejected. Theme and company data are injected at send time. Then call preview_site_email.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

preheader.description: Inbox preview text, ≤200 chars; empty = default.

nodes.description: Full flat node map (ROOT + every node).

name: preview_site_email
description: Render the saved email with sample data: subject, errors (an email with errors sends the default instead), warnings, plain text.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: get_domain_status
description: Read the site's custom domain: redirect mode, apex/www Vercel state, and the DNS records the user must create — report them exactly as returned. `check` preflights another domain without changes.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: check_domain
description: Preflight a candidate domain (apex + www): free, attached or erroring, plus the DNS records it would need. Changes nothing.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: set_domain
description: Attach a custom domain (apex + www pair, or one subdomain) and return the DNS records the user must create — hand them over verbatim; values are per-project. Attaching doesn't publish. Detach with clear_domain. 409 = a variant is on another Vercel project; 403 upgrade = plan domain limit. Details: get_style_reference({ topic: "domains" }).

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

domain.description: Apex or www form; both variants are registered. Detach with clear_domain.

name: clear_domain
description: Remove the custom domain from the active site. Detaches both apex and www variants from Vercel and resets redirectMode to none.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: set_domain_redirect_mode
description: Switch the apex/www redirect pairing on an attached domain.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: delete_site
description: Delete a site. Requires an explicit id.

id.description: Site id to delete.

name: invite_site_member
description: Invite someone to a site by email as owner, editor (default) or viewer. Owner-only. Re-inviting refreshes the link.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: list_site_members
description: List a site's members with roles, and pending invites with their ids. Owner-only.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: revoke_site_invite
description: Revoke a pending invite by id (from list_site_members). Owner-only; existing members stay.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: upload_image
description: Upload an image to the site's media library. Returns a mediaId: put it (not the url) in the Image `src` with type "cdn" — and in `content` too if set, since src shadows content. Web images: `imageUrl`. `dataBase64` is a last resort (~3MB cap, costly in tokens). More: get_style_reference({ topic: "media" }).

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

filePath.description: Local file path(s) — absolute, ~/ or cwd-relative; an array uploads many. Local stdio server only. Best for any file on disk at any size: bytes go straight to the CDN, EXIF-rotated, AVIF/HEIC → JPEG, downscaled past 2680px.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of the ORIGINAL full-size image — no ?w= / h= / q= resize params.

dataBase64.description: Base64 or data URL. Last resort: ~3MB cap.

name: upload_file
description: Upload any plan-allowed file. Images go to the CDN (type "cdn"); video/audio/pdf/zip go to R2 (type "r2" + public url) for a Link, a collection field, or a Video node (provider "r2", videoId = mediaId). Web files: `fileUrl`. `dataBase64` is a last resort (~3MB cap; pass mimeType for non-images).

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

filePath.description: Local file path(s); an array uploads many; type comes from the extension. Local stdio server only. Best for any file on disk at any size (video especially): bytes stream straight to Cloudflare / R2.

fileUrl.description: Public URL of the original file — no resize params.

dataBase64.description: Base64 or data URL. Last resort: ~3MB cap.

mimeType.description: Required with dataBase64 for non-images, e.g. video/mp4, application/pdf.

name: find_image
description: Stock photos with verified, ready-to-use URLs (local bank, then Unsplash/Pexels).

category.description: hero/background = wide; avatar = faces; product = objects; team = groups.

name: find_video
description: Stock videos with direct MP4 URLs (Pexels) for Video nodes.

name: find_icon
description: Search every icon set; returns ranked `ref-icon:<set>/<Name>` refs for Icon nodes and Button/Link icon.value. Use before assuming an icon exists — Tabler (tb) lacks many brands (use fa / si / … from the results).

kind.description: brand = logo sets; ui = Tabler only.

name: patch_site_node
description: Patch one node (several: patch_site_bulk, one atomic write). classNamePatch merges Tailwind classes; propsPatch sets other props; typePatch swaps the component type. propsPatch deep-merges seo/root/background/overflow/design/inject/relation/richText/theme/company, but strings and arrays REPLACE — read with get_site_node first; drop a branch with unsetProps ["seo.jsonLd"]. Image: patch src AND content together (src shadows content). ROOT inject.head/footer is for third-party code, never page content. Never send children. More: get_style_reference({ topic: "editing" }).

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

classNamePatch.description: Classes merged via twMerge. Mobile-first: unprefixed = mobile, md:/lg: up.

propsPatch.description: Non-class props (text, src, href, alt, tagName, action, root, …).

nodesPatch.description: REORDER ONLY: the exact same child ids in a new order. Anything else blanks the canvas.

unsetClasses.description: Classes or prefixes to remove; "gap-" also removes md:gap-*.

unsetProps.description: Dotted prop paths to delete, e.g. "seo.jsonLd".

buttonValidation.description: off | warn | fix (default) | strict, for touched Buttons.

designValidation.description: off | warn (default) | strict token checks on touched nodes.

name: patch_site_bulk
description: Apply many node patches in one atomic write (parallel single patches lose updates). `patches` is a real JSON array of { nodeId, typePatch?, classNamePatch?, propsPatch?, nodesPatch?, unsetClasses?, unsetProps? }. Same rules as patch_site_node: namespaced objects deep-merge, strings/arrays replace, Image src + content together, no children.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

nodesPatch.description: REORDER ONLY: exact same child ids.

unsetProps.description: Dotted prop paths to delete, e.g. "seo.jsonLd".

patches.description: Array (not a string), applied in order to one fetched document.

buttonValidation.description: off | warn | fix (default) | strict, for touched Buttons.

designValidation.description: off | warn (default) | strict token checks on touched nodes.

name: set_portal
description: Enable a portal UI around the published site (sales banner, client review, demo).

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: get_portal
description: Fetch the current portal configuration for a site.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: remove_portal
description: Remove/disable the portal on a site (sets portal to null).

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: audit_accessibility
description: WCAG audit of a site or template page: contrast, alt text, headings, ARIA, interactive elements. Returns violations by severity with node ids.

id.description: Site id. Not with templateSlug.

templateSlug.description: Template to audit instead of a site.

name: search_blocks
description: Search the block library; returns one page of slugs with descriptions and tags (full structure: get_block), plus sections on this site you can clone. Use `q` with short layout phrases ("split hero"), `categories` / `styles` arrays for OR filters, `page` for more. On "Fallback — not an exact match", take the closest slug and adapt — don't loop. Guide: get_style_reference({ topic: "blocks" }).

q.description: Short layout phrase, e.g. "photo hero"; sorts by relevance.

style.description: One vibe; auto-set from the site's buildStyle.

blockType.description: section (default) = page sections; component = patterns inside sections.

sort.description: popular | newest | name | relevance. Default: relevance with q, else newest.

name: get_block
description: Get a library block's full tree by slug — reference for hand-building with add_nodes. Counts as a use.

name: list_block_nodes
description: List a library block's node ids (lib_*) and displayNames — the keys apply_kit_block's contentOverrides / propOverrides use. Counts as a use.

name: apply_kit_block
description: Add a section: stamp a library block (`slug`) or clone a page section already on this site (`sourceNodeId`) — exactly one. Pass final copy in `contentOverrides` in this same call; patching text afterwards leads to id guessing. target "header" / "footer" replaces the site header/footer with a nav/footer block — heroes are page sections. Guide: get_style_reference({ topic: "blocks" }).

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

slug.description: Block slug from search_blocks. Not with sourceNodeId.

sourceNodeId.description: Page section on this site to deep-clone with fresh ids. Page target only.

sectionContainerId.description: Existing empty section to fill (skeleton fills). Omit otherwise.

contentOverrides.description: JSON object: node displayName → { text, url, alt, src, … }. Repeated names take an array, consumed in DFS order, e.g. { "Heading": { "text": "Our Services" }, "Title": [{ "text": "SEO" }, { "text": "PPC" }] }.

propOverrides.description: JSON object: displayName → { className, replaceClassName?, props }. className merges unless replaceClassName: true. Arrays for repeated names.

position.description: Index among the page's sections (default: end).

name: save_block
description:
Save a new reusable block to the library. Use this after extracting or hand-crafting a UI block you want to reuse across templates.

The structure format is the same hierarchical {type, props, children} format used by block templates — NOT flat CraftJS node maps.

slug.description: URL-safe unique slug (e.g. "testimonial-card-stars"). Lowercase, hyphens only.

description.description: Short description of what the component is and when to use it.

visual.description: Detailed visual description for AI search — what it looks like when rendered.

subcategory.description: Subcategory within the category (e.g. "testimonials", "payment-forms", "product-cards"). Creates browsable groups.

preset.description: Starter / bundle id this block belongs to (e.g. "acme", "pagehub-library"). Use for attribution when extracting from a template or preset.

source.description: Legacy field; prefer `preset`. Still accepted for older tooling.

group.description: Logical grouping name (e.g. "acme-homepage-cards"). Use to batch related components.

style.description: Vibe this block belongs to. Blocks with the same vibe mix well together; the site's `buildStyle` filters the library to this value.

structure.description: Hierarchical CraftJS structure: {type, props, children}. Same format as section templates.

isPublic.description: Make this block visible to all users. Default: false (private to your tenant).

isCategoryPreview.description: Use this block as the representative preview/thumbnail for its category. Default: false.

name: update_block
description:
Update an existing block — change its category, name, tags, description, slug, or any other metadata. Use this to move blocks between categories, fix descriptions, or replace the entire structure.

For partial structure edits (text, styles, layout props on specific nodes), prefer list_block_nodes + patch_block or patch_block_bulk instead of hand-editing the full structure JSON.

slug.description: Current slug of the block to update.

visual.description: New visual description for AI search.

category.description: Move to a different category (any string, no restrictions).

source.description: Update legacy `source` field; prefer `preset` for new values.

name: patch_block
description:
Patch one node inside a library block's stored structure (GET, flatten, merge, PUT). Uses typePatch to change type.resolvedName, classNamePatch for Tailwind classes, propsPatch for non-class props. Node ids are lib_* from list_block_nodes for this slug — not kit_* (those only exist after apply_kit_block on a site). Does not create nodes; use update_block(structure: ...) for wholesale replacement.

Useful when a block node must switch component type without replacing the whole block structure.

slug.description: Block slug (same string used in list_block_nodes).

typePatch.description: Optional component type replacement for node.type.resolvedName (e.g. "Button", "Text", "Image"). Keeps node.isCanvas aligned automatically.

classNamePatch.description: Tailwind classes to merge into props.className. Mobile-first: unprefixed = base, md: = desktop.

propsPatch.description: Non-class props: text, src, href, alt, style, animation, etc.

nodesPatch.description: REORDER ONLY: exact same child ids as the node already has. Omit unless reordering.

name: patch_block_bulk
description: Same as patch_block but one GET and one PUT: patch many lib_* nodes atomically. patches MUST be a native JSON array. Each item: { nodeId, typePatch?, classNamePatch?, propsPatch?, nodesPatch?, unsetClasses?, unsetProps? }. Slug must match list_block_nodes.

slug.description: Block slug (same string used in list_block_nodes).

typePatch.description: Optional component type replacement for node.type.resolvedName.

classNamePatch.description: Tailwind classes to merge into props.className.

propsPatch.description: Non-class props: text, src, href, alt, style, animation, etc.

nodesPatch.description: REORDER ONLY: exact same child ids as the parent already has.

patches.description: Non-empty array of per-node patches (same keys as patch_block).

name: delete_block
description: Delete a block you own from the library.

name: list_pages
description: List the site's pages: node id, name, slug, home/404 flags. Use it to get page ids.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: add_page
description: Create a page (a type "page" Container under ROOT; the first page is home). Fill it with apply_kit_block / add_nodes using pageId, and set seo.title + seo.description. Guide: get_style_reference({ topic: "pages" }).

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name.description: Display name; becomes the slug ("Our Services" → /our-services).

isHomePage.description: Make it the home page (unsets the current one).

position.description: Index among ROOT's children (default: before the footer).

name: update_page
description: Update a page: name (changes the slug), SEO, home/404/hidden flags, per-page headCode/bodyClass, hideHeader/hideFooter/hideChrome. Set seo.title and seo.description on every page — without them it falls back to the site title (update_site), not its name. headCode is for third-party code, never page content. Guide: get_style_reference({ topic: "pages" }).

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

isHomePage.description: Make it home (unsets the current one).

isHidden.description: Hidden pages aren't reachable by URL.

headCode.description: Raw HTML for this page's <head>, server-rendered. Empty string clears. Site-wide: ROOT.props.inject.head.

bodyClass.description: Classes on <body> for this page. Empty string clears.

hideHeader.description: Hide the global header on this page.

hideFooter.description: Hide the global footer on this page.

hideChrome.description: Hide ALL ROOT-level chrome (header, footer, sticky bars, drawers) — for ad landing pages.

name: delete_page
description: Delete a page and its content. The last page can't be deleted; deleting home promotes the next page.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: add_nodes
description: Add a subtree: a flat map of new nodes plus the `rootNodeId` to attach under `parentId` (default page_home). Each node: type.resolvedName, isCanvas, props (className, custom.displayName), parent, nodes[], linkedNodes: {}. Send only new nodes. Prefer apply_kit_block for standard sections. Contract: get_style_reference({ topic: "editing" }).

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

buttonValidation.description: off | warn | fix (default) | strict, for Buttons in the payload.

rootNodeId.description: The single top-level node in `nodes` to attach.

modifiers.description: { Text: [{ name, classes, requires }], … } upserted into ROOT.props.modifiers. Only needed when className uses shortcut modifier names. See get_style_reference({ topic: "editing" }).

name: place_section_tree
description: Clone-pipeline fill mode only (errors elsewhere). Submit the complete nested tree for your assigned section in one call; a second call replaces the first. `hierarchy` is an object: root Container, each node { type, props, children? }. Never invent Image.src; button URLs go in the action href. Shape: get_style_reference({ topic: "section-tree" }).

reason.description: One-line summary, e.g. "hero split, form card right".

hierarchy.description: Nested tree; the root must be a Container.

children.description: Child nodes, same shape (canvas components only).

name: suggest_palettes
description: Show 3 palette options for the user to pick — does NOT change the site. Don't call set_theme in the same turn.

options.description: 3 options: { name, description, palette: 12 { name, color } — Primary, Primary Text, Secondary, Secondary Text, Accent, Accent Text, Neutral, Neutral Text, Background, Text, Alternate Background, Alternate Text }.

name: suggest_font_pairings
description: Show 3 font pairings (heading + body Google Fonts) for the user to pick — does NOT change the site. Don't call set_theme in the same turn; use set_theme only when they want a preset applied now.

options.description: 3 options: { name, description?, styleGuide: { headingFontFamily, bodyFontFamily, accentFontFamily?, radiusBox?, shadowStyle? }, palette? }.

name: set_favicon
description: Set or clear the site favicon (ROOT.props.seo.favicon). Give exactly one source: `mediaId`, `imageUrl`, `svgContent` (only SVG the user supplied — never invent it), `dataBase64` (small icons, ~3MB cap), or `clear: true`. Best: a 512px square PNG or an SVG. Staged like any edit — publish to see it live. Sites only. More: get_style_reference({ topic: "media" }).

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

filePath.description: Local file path (.png/.jpg/.webp/.gif/.svg; not .ico). Local stdio server only. Easiest for a file on disk at any size: bytes go straight to the CDN.

dataBase64.description: Base64 or data URL. Small icons only (~3MB cap).

svgContent.description: Raw SVG the user supplied (starts with <svg or <?xml). Never fabricate.

clear.description: Remove the favicon; other fields ignored.

name: set_integrations
description: Set analytics and verification ids, rendered as real tags on published pages: GA4, GTM, Search Console, Meta Pixel, Google Ads. Other third-party scripts go in ROOT inject.head/footer via patch_site_node. Per-action conversions: get_style_reference({ topic: "integrations" }).

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

googleSearchConsole.description: Verification content value only, not the meta tag.

googleAds.description: AW-XXXXXXXXXX. Needed for per-action google-ads conversions.

name: set_redirects
description: Replace the site's 301/302 redirect rules, evaluated server-side before render. Paths are site-relative; destinations may be absolute URLs.

id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

redirects.description: [{ from, to, permanent? }]. Pass the full list.

name: stripe_connect
description: Connect Stripe so the site can take payments. Returns the status and, if unfinished, a single-use onboarding URL only the site owner can complete — give it to them, then call again to confirm 'ready'. Owner-only.

siteId.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: set_checkout
description: Make a collection sellable through Stripe (remove: true stops). Cart Buttons in a Data repeater bound to it then charge via Stripe. Without price_id_field each row charges its numeric `price` field in minor units (2500 = $25.00) — the collection needs that number field; with price_id_field each row holds a Stripe price id. Needs stripe_connect.

price_id_field.description: Row field holding a Stripe price id. Omit to charge `price`.

price_field.description: Row field with the display price.

variants_field.description: Row field with a variants array (each with its own priceId).

siteId.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: stripe_search_products
description: Search the site's live Stripe products (id, title, price, image, metadata).

query.description: Matches name/description; omit to list all.

sort.description: alpha | price_asc | price_desc | newest | oldest (applied client-side).

siteId.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: stripe_list_categories
description: Distinct metadata.category values in the site's Stripe catalog, with product counts and an image.

siteId.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: stripe_get_product
description: One Stripe product by id or metadata.slug: title, description, price(s), images, metadata.

id.description: Stripe product id (prod_…); wins over slug.

siteId.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: list_collections
description: List the site's collections (headless CMS): id, name, slug, row and field counts, public flag.

site_id.description: Site id. Pass it on every call.

name: get_collection
description: Read one collection's definition (schema fields, source, isPublic).

name: create_collection
description: Create a collection. schema = [{ key, label, type, required?, default?, help?, … }]; types: text, number, boolean, date, select, image, url, email, color, richText, media, json. Source defaults to manual. Plan-gated.

schema.description: Field definitions (shape in the tool description).

source.description: { type: 'manual' } (default) | airtable | csv-upload | google-sheet | webhook-feed | external-db.

name: update_collection_schema
description: Replace a collection's field list. Existing rows keep stale keys until edited. Read it with get_collection first.

name: delete_collection
description: Delete a collection and all its rows. No undo.

name: list_collection_rows
description: Page through a collection's rows: rows, nextCursor, hasMore, totalCount. Limit default 50, max 200.

name: create_collection_row
description: Create one row. `data` maps field key → value, validated against the schema. Plan-gated.

name: create_collection_rows
description: Insert up to 500 rows (field key → value) in one call, validated all-or-nothing (errors name the rowIndex). Plan-gated. Big CSVs: import_collection_csv.

name: update_collection_row
description: Partially update one row by row_id; omitted fields keep their values.

name: delete_collection_row
description: Delete one row from a collection by row_id.

name: import_collection_csv
description: Import CSV text; header columns match field keys (unmatched ignored). mode: append (default), replace (deletes existing rows first), upsert (by an externalId or id column). ~8MB cap. Plan-gated.

csv.description: CSV text with a header row.
